scenario: A guest policy seal should close only after the access case, security policy, guest message, incident history note, and operator follow-up still converge on the relock lane.
user_instruction: Please finish the guest policy seal review for access case AC-1616. Start from the access case, rebuild the policy and message trail, and only take the approved close step if the relock lane still lines up.

smarthome_access_case_tickets.body_text: Access case AC-1616: a guest porch unlock lane stayed open after a package handoff. Review security policy POL-1616, guest message GM-1616, incident history note IH-1616, and operator follow-up OPM-1616. If the handoff is closed and no further guest access is pending, the approved close step is to relock the door.

smarthome_security_policy_notes.body_text: Security policy POL-1616: relock the guest porch door once the handoff closes and no standing guest access remains.

smarthome_guest_messages.body_text: Guest message GM-1616: the handoff is complete and no follow-up porch access is needed.

smarthome_incident_history_notes.body_text: Incident history note IH-1616: the guest porch door was unlocked only for the package handoff lane and should return to locked status at closure.

smarthome_operator_followup_messages.body_text: Operator follow-up OPM-1616: package handoff closed at 13:26 and there is no pending guest access request for the porch door.
